_comment: Hooked game routines and plain patches (offsets in main, build E0F3CCFA...). Each enabled hook's first word is replaced by a branch to a gate in unused space at the end of main's code; the gate jumps to our handler when the module has filled its table slot, otherwise it runs the original first word and continues. Disabled hooks keep their slot but patch nothing. Overlay sites from Fast Travel's game.hpp (MIT), checked against the dump. Since v1.0.1 the controller is hooked through main's import table entries (the "got" list, changed at run time) and the drawing through the callers ("calls"), so nothing here touches the sites Fast Travel and Hyrule Cheat Menu patch.

hooks.name: LoadGraphicsProcs
hooks.what: graphics function table load: (device, lookup) [off since v1.0.1: Fast Travel patches this entry; see "calls"]

hooks.name: DrawLayer
hooks.what: draws one screen layer: (display, layer, sort key) [off since v1.0.1: Fast Travel patches this entry; see "calls"]

hooks.name: CollectIcons
hooks.what: map icon manager: per-frame update of the Skulltula/heart icons (this)

hooks.name: Decompress
hooks.what: resource decompressor (zstd): (this, load arg, resource, u32* out size, u32* out alloc size, bool* allocated) -> buffer

patches.what: Skulltula: empty save-key table -> show (cbz w8, #0x209260 -> cbz w8, #0x2092d8)
Skulltula: key not found -> show (b #0x209260 -> b #0x2092d8)
Heart: collected -> hide, otherwise show (tbz w0, #0, #0x209260 -> tbnz w0, #0, #0x209260)
Skulltula: key not found -> show (tbnz w11, #0x1f, #0x209260 -> tbnz w11, #0x1f, #0x2092d8)
Skulltula: collected -> hide, otherwise show (tbnz w8, #0, #0x2092d8 -> tbz w8, #0, #0x2092d8)

inline.name: CollectDecide
inline.what: per Skulltula/heart icon, before the game decides: decide(manager, index) -> 0 hide, 1 game's rule, 2 show

calls.name: DrawLayer
calls.what: the three calls of the screen-layer draw routine (main+0x4CD60): (display, layer, sort key). Hooked at the callers so a mod that patches the routine's own entry (Fast Travel) still runs inside it.

calls.name: DeviceInit
calls.what: the renderer's nvnDeviceInitialize call (blr x24, with x23 = nvnDeviceGetProcAddress): handler(device, builder, initialize, getProcAddress)
